grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 13014 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0 for silver.silver_airport_weather. airport_code has 3 distinct values and observed_hour_utc has 4341 distinct values; 3 x 4341 = 13023, closely matching the 13014 row_count, which shows the table carries approximately one row per airport per observed hour rather than a pre-aggregated rollup. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, no exact duplicate rows exist for the identity tuple to absorb, so the grain is declared as transaction with a derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) rather than aggregated.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter station code (EWR, JFK, LGA; 3 distinct values, null_rate 0.0) identifying the airport for the observation, combined with observed_hour_utc to form the event identity.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the weather observation, spanning 2013-01-01T06:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 across 4341 distinct hourly values with null_rate 0.0; the event-timestamp of the fact.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (181 distinct values, 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, null_rate 0.0), a local-time view alongside the UTC time column.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day of the observation (0-23, 24 distinct values, null_rate 0.0); a numeric label describing time-of-day rather than a quantity to aggregate.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit, ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; a measured quantity compared and aggregated across observations.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in Fahrenheit, ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; a measured weather quantity.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage, ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; a measured weather quantity.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (0-360, 37 distinct values), nullable in 1.6828% of rows (219 of 13014), likely undefined during calm-wind periods; treated as a directional label rather than an additive measure.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour, ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values, nullable in 0.0154% of rows (2 nulls); a measured quantity.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour, ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212 across 35 distinct values, nullable in 74.5505% of rows (9702 nulls), consistent with gusts only being recorded when they occur; a measured quantity.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation accumulation in inches, ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; a measured quantity.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars, ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values, nullable in 11.4953% of rows (1496 nulls); a measured quantity.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility distance in miles, with 20 distinct capped values from 0.0 to 10.0 and null_rate 0.0; a measured quantity.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport; 3 distinct values, null_rate 0.0); a descriptive dimension of the airport.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality hosting the airport (New York or Newark; 2 distinct values, null_rate 0.0); a descriptive dimension of the airport.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21; 3 distinct values, null_rate 0.0) corresponding one-to-one with the 3 airports; a static descriptive attribute rather than a per-observation measure.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the airport's longest runway in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511; 3 distinct values, null_rate 0.0) corresponding one-to-one with the 3 airports; a static descriptive attribute.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the source record was captured by the ingestion process (3 distinct values clustered around 2026-09-02T23:26:11 to 2026-09-02T23:26:13, null_rate 0.0); a pipeline capture time distinct from the business event time, so mapped as a dimension rather than the time column.

category_description: Each row represents one hourly weather observation recorded at one of three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), capturing temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility readings for that airport at that hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, fixing its time column, time grain, degenerate identity, and per-field roles so the deterministic modeling engine, the sole consumer of the rendered contract, can generate the gold fact model without further interpretation.
usage: Deterministic code renders this proposal into an ODCS mapping contract draft identified as gold_airport_weather_observations_mapping; the frozen mapping-contract schema, a validator, and datacontract lint gate the render before a human reviewer approves or edits the draft, after which the modeling engine consumes the approved contract to emit the gold fact and its derived observation_identity key over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc).
limitations: This mapping does not filter, impute, or otherwise transform rows, including the 74.5505% of rows with null wind_gust_mph, the 11.4953% with null pressure_mb, or the 1.6828% with null wind_dir_degrees; it leaves any exclusion, imputation, or quality-rule enforcement on those nulls to downstream consumers and review, and it declares no ownership, classification, service-level, or access-policy attributes.
